description: This file defines a custom exception class SqlValidationException used within the security exception handling of the Fineract project. It extends an abstract exception class and adds specific messaging for SQL validation errors.

classes.name: SqlValidationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for SQL validation errors within the security module of Fineract. It extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException and sets a specific error message.

methods.name: SqlValidationException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a given error message and a specific error code.
